title: A rejected date change leaves the agreement intact

messages.body: Our agreed event is September 4, 2027 in Willow Room for 18 guests.
Can we change the date to September 11, 2027?
No, September 11 is unavailable. I am declining that change; September 4, 2027 remains agreed.
Understood. We will keep September 4 and drop the September 11 request.
